fontLicensePolicy: Existing renamed Source Sans 3 Regular WOFF2 reused unchanged at weight400 in both variants. Original source and OFL notice retained.
mode: Built-in image_gen produced five photographic source assets, including three transparent cutouts. Original PNGs copied unchanged. Native SVG composition/fitting, plant visibility, wording and object selection; typography composed separately.

layout_record.method: Each comparison changes one declared cue: seedling visibility over an unchanged book; one explanatory text node beside an unchanged cord photo; or the selected ladder/bridge source object within the same frame. Surrounding typography, layout, copy except the declared anchor line, paper and presentation remain fixed. The third case intentionally changes source-object geometry/material appearance; other cases reuse identical photographic bytes/crops.

comparisonPolicy: Book: only seedling cue opacity0→1, fixed book source/crop and fixed plant placement. Cord: only one explanatory textContent changes with all style and geometry fixed. Peer circle: only selected object href ladder→bridge within the same frame/fitting, with copy/type/ground/paper presentation fixed. Different object geometries, textures and object-specific light are declared parts of source replacement. No independent poster generations or measured isolation of semantic effects.

verification.textBounds: within the declared paper or phone surface
verification.pixelCheck: Only intended declared metaphor intervention regions differ.
verification.scope: DOM normalization permits only seedling opacity, one text node’s textContent or selected-object href. Source bytes are fixed and embedded identically; the third pair selects a different declared object. Pixel changes stay within the plant bounds, anchor-line region or image frame. Fonts, bounds, overflow and inline/image equivalence checked wide/narrow. The seedling is a native photographic composite; the ladder/bridge comparison intentionally changes object-specific geometry/texture/lighting.
verification.visualInspection: All three wide and three stacked saved browser comparisons inspected; the book/growth mark inspected at 32, 48 and 96 pixels.
verification.scopedTests: 24 article/comparison tests passed across the new metaphor suite and silhouette neighbor suite. Bounded mark geometry passed (one test; four unrelated tests skipped). Content validated878 entities; production compilation658 excludes this draft. All51 article hashes and342 registered asset hashes/dimensions checked. Scoped lint and formatting passed.

limitations: Editorial intended readings and plausible alternatives, not tested comprehension/recall/attendance improvements. Word–image comparisons include multimodal metaphor. All events/offers/artwork are fictional. Book/seedling composite is conceptual, not documentary evidence. Ladder/bridge cutouts are not matched images of one object and cannot isolate semantic effects from shape/material appearance. No physical print proof or real-world structural claim.
